title.zh: 新西兰找房与租房全流程：整租 vs 合租（Flatting）实战
title.en: Finding a Home in NZ: Whole-House Tenancy vs Flatting

summary.zh: 彻底分清 Tenant（受租赁法保护）与 Flatmate（合租室友）的法律天壤之别，掌握 Trade Me 找房、看房礼仪与拿下高分租房推荐信技巧。
summary.en: Understand the huge legal gap between Tenant and Flatmate, navigate Trade Me Property viewings, and build a winning rental application.

terms.zh: 正式整租合同（受《住宅租赁法》RTA 全面保护）
合租室友（跟二房东或同住屋主签协议，不受 RTA 租赁仲裁庭保护！）
寄宿客（与房东同住且通常包餐/包水电，不受 RTA 保护）
预约看房（新西兰绝大部分整租须在 Trade Me/Barfoot/Ray White 线上预约统一时段看房）
租房推荐人（过往房东或雇主/本地朋友出具的信用背书）
入住验房单（入住时逐屋拍照记录所有划痕污渍，退租拿回全额押金的命根子！）

title.zh: 核心法律区分：整租（Tenant）vs 合租（Flatmate / Boarder）
title.en: Crucial Legal Divide: Tenant vs Flatmate vs Boarder

body.zh: 新移民落地常在微信或 Trade Me 租单间，但很多人不知道：**是否签在房东主合同上，决定了你有没有法律保护！**
body.en: Whether your name is on the main Tenancy Agreement determines whether the Residential Tenancies Act (RTA) protects you:

keyPoints.zh: ✅ **整租租客（Tenant）**：与屋主/正规物业中介（Barfoot & Thompson / Ray White / Harcourts 等）签正式 Tenancy Agreement，受 RTA 全面保护，押金交政府监管，纠纷走 **Tenancy Tribunal**。
keyPoints.en: Tenants have full RTA rights, government-held bonds, and Tenancy Tribunal protection.

keyPoints.zh: ⚠️ **合租室友（Flatmate）**：跟已经整租下来的“头房客（Head Tenant）”或同住屋主租一个房间，**不受《住宅租赁法》保护**！押金也不进政府监管，遇纠纷只能走 **Disputes Tribunal（小额仲裁庭）**。
keyPoints.en: Flatmates living with a head tenant or resident landlord are NOT covered by the RTA—disputes go to the Disputes Tribunal.

keyPoints.zh: 合租必做保护动作：哪怕是熟人合租，也一定要上 `tenancy.govt.nz` 下载一份官方 **Flat-sharing Agreement** 书面写明：周租、是否包水电网、提前几周通知搬走、押金金额与退还条件！
keyPoints.en: Always sign Tenancy Services’ free Flat-sharing Agreement template stating rent, bills, notice period, and bond refund rules.

title.zh: 新西兰找房主流平台与高成功率看房（Viewing）策略
title.en: Where to Search & How to Stand Out at NZ Property Viewings

body.zh: 新西兰找整租最核心的平台是 **Trade Me Property**（国民级）与 **Realestate.co.nz**；找合租单间用 **Trade Me Flatmates Wanted**、Facebook 城市合租群或华人 Skykiwi（务必防骗）。
body.en: Trade Me Property dominates NZ rentals, supplemented by Realestate.co.nz and major agency sites.

keyPoints.zh: 提前准备「租房个人简介包」：没有本地租房历史时，准备好 **工作 Offer/雇主证明信 + 银行存款余额截图（遮掉账号敏感位）+ 2 位推荐人联系方式 + 一段礼貌的家庭/工作介绍**，看房当天立刻提交申请！
keyPoints.en: No NZ rental history yet? Attach your job offer/income proof, savings snapshot, referees, and a warm short bio.

keyPoints.zh: 看房 5 个必查硬指标：① **朝向与采光（南半球朝北 North-facing 才有阳光！）**；② 窗框与衣柜角落有无**黑霉斑（Mould）和冷凝水**；③ 是否装了 **Heat Pump（冷暖空调）** 和双层玻璃（Double Glazing）；④ 手机信号与光纤（Fibre）盒位置；⑤ 街边停车与早晚通勤路况。
keyPoints.en: Inspect: North-facing sun (Southern Hemisphere!), mould/condensation, Heat Pump & double glazing, Fibre ONT box, and parking.

keyPoints.zh: 严禁向租客收中介费：**Letting Fee（租客中介费）在新西兰已全面违法**，正规中介绝不会向租客收任何申请费或看房费！
keyPoints.en: Charging tenants letting fees or viewing fees is strictly illegal in NZ.

title.zh: 入住第一天必做救命动作：入住验房单 + 100 张高清照片！
title.en: Move-In Day Lifesaver: Property Inspection Report + Timestamped Photos

body.zh: 退租时被房东/物业扣掉几百上千刀押金，90% 都是因为入住时没留证据，说不清“地毯污渍/墙面磕碰/灶台划痕”是本来就有的还是你弄坏的。
body.en: Most bond disputes happen because tenants didn’t document pre-existing scuffs, carpet stains, or chipped paint on Day 1.

keyPoints.zh: 搬进家具**之前**，用手机拍下每个房间的墙面、地毯、门框、烤箱内部、抽油烟机油网、窗台、卫浴硅胶缝与花园杂草状态，并把明显瑕疵全部写进 **Property Inspection Report** 发邮件给房东留档！
keyPoints.en: Photograph every room, oven, carpet, and garden BEFORE unpacking, list every flaw on the inspection report, and email copies to the landlord.

keyPoints.zh: 记下入住当天的 **电表、燃气表与水表读数（拍照片）**，防止替上一任租客背账单。
keyPoints.en: Photograph electricity, gas, and water meter readings on move-in day.

title.zh: 看房现场 & 申请租房加分英文模板
title.en: Viewing Conversation & Winning Tenant Cover Note

body.zh: Kiwi 房东和物业经理最看重“爱干净、按时交租、稳定好沟通”的租客：
body.en: NZ landlords prize tidy, reliable, communicative tenants:

dialogueLines.speaker: You (At Viewing)
dialogueLines.en: Kia ora [Name], lovely place! Quick question—is the property fully compliant with the Healthy Homes standards, and is Fibre internet already installed to the house?
dialogueLines.zh: 你好 [姓名]，房子真不错！顺便问一下——这套房已经完全符合 Healthy Homes 保暖防潮标准了吗？光纤入户盒装好了吗？
dialogueLines.subtextZh: 一句专业提问既帮你排雷，又让中介知道你是个懂规矩的靠谱租客！

dialogueLines.speaker: You (Application Bio)
dialogueLines.en: Kia ora! We are a tidy, non-smoking couple working full-time in [Industry]. Although we recently relocated to NZ, we have strong savings, stable employment offers, and glowing references from our employer. We take great pride in caring for a home as if it were our own.
dialogueLines.zh: 你好！我们是一对爱干净、不抽烟的全职上班族伴侣。虽然刚来新西兰，但有充足存款、稳定工作 Offer 和雇主推荐。我们会像爱护自己的家一样精心维护房屋。

prompt.zh: 在新西兰看房，如果你特别在意客厅和主卧冬天暖和、日照充足，应该优先挑什么朝向的窗户？
prompt.en: In New Zealand, which window orientation gets the most winter sunlight and warmth?

text.zh: 朝北（North-facing），因为新西兰在南半球！
text.en: North-facing, because New Zealand is in the Southern Hemisphere!

feedback.zh: 记住南半球规律：朝北采光最好最暖和，朝南（South-facing）冬季阴冷最容易发霉！
feedback.en: Spot on! North-facing is prized; south-facing rooms are colder and damper in winter.

text.zh: 朝南（South-facing），跟国内一样坐北朝南
text.en: South-facing, just like the Northern Hemisphere

feedback.zh: 相反啦！在南半球太阳在北边天空运行，朝南房间终年难见直射阳光，冬天又冷又潮。
feedback.en: Opposite! In the Southern Hemisphere the sun sits to the north.

prompt.zh: 你从一位已经整租下三房的华人朋友手里分租了一间次卧（未上房东主合同），属于 Flatmate。若发生押金纠纷，应找哪个机构？
prompt.en: You rent a room as a flatmate from a head tenant (not on the main landlord contract). Where do bond disputes go?

text.zh: Disputes Tribunal（小额仲裁庭），因为 Flatmate 不受《住宅租赁法》RTA 管辖
text.en: Disputes Tribunal, as flatmates are not covered by the RTA

feedback.zh: 精准避坑！所以合租也一定要签书面 Flat-sharing Agreement 留好转账记录。
feedback.en: Correct—always sign a written flat-sharing agreement!

text.zh: Tenancy Tribunal（租赁仲裁庭）免费处理
text.en: Tenancy Tribunal under the RTA

feedback.zh: Tenancy Tribunal 只管正式 Tenant 与房东之间的纠纷，不管 Flatmate 合租纠纷。
feedback.en: Tenancy Tribunal only covers formal RTA tenancies.

actionTip.zh: 看房前上 tenancy.govt.nz 收藏官方《Property Inspection Report》与《Flat-sharing Agreement》模板，入住当天务必先拍 100 张全屋细节照！
actionTip.en: Save Tenancy Services’ Property Inspection Report and photograph every corner before moving furniture in.

title.zh: 租房法规与 2025–2026 新政深度避坑（含宠物押金与解约红线）
title.en: NZ Tenancy Law & 2025–2026 Rules (Pet Bonds, Notices & Healthy Homes)

summary.zh: 逐条拆解 2025–2026 最新租赁法：90 天无理由/42 天/21 天解约规则、2025.12 宠物押金新政、2025.07 Healthy Homes 全面强制达标与 Bond 押金退还维权。
summary.en: Master the 2025–2026 RTA reforms: 90/42/21-day notice periods, the Dec 2025 Pet Bond regime, mandatory Healthy Homes compliance, and bond protection.

officialSource: Tenancy Services (tenancy.govt.nz) / Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 2024

terms.zh: 常规押金（法定上限 4 周租金，须在 23 个工作日内上交政府监管）
宠物押金（2025.12.1 生效，最高额外收 2 周租金，同样交政府监管）
无限期租约（灵活可按法定通知期解约，到期固定约会自动转为此类）
固定期限租约（如 1 年，期内双方一般不得单方提前解约）
健康住宅强制标准（2025.7.1 起全纽私房必须全部达标，违者最高罚 $7,200）
14 天限期整改通知书（房东拖延修漏水/修暖气时最锋利的法定武器！）

title.zh: 【2025.01.30 生效】周期性租约解约通知期最新规则（90 / 42 / 21 天）
title.en: Periodic Tenancy Notice Periods (In Force Since 30 Jan 2025)

body.zh: 2025 年 1 月 30 日起新西兰大幅修改了解约通知期，签约和规划搬家务必按最新天数计算：
body.en: Major notice-period reforms took effect on 30 January 2025:

keyPoints.zh: 🏠 **房东无理由解约（No-Cause）**：已恢复！房东提前 **90 天**书面通知即可终止周期性租约，无需说明理由。
keyPoints.en: Landlord no-cause termination: 90 days’ written notice.

keyPoints.zh: 🔑 **房东特定理由解约**：缩短至 **42 天**（适用情形：房东本人或直系亲属需搬入自住至少 90 天；房子已签无条件买卖合同且买家要求空房交割；合同已写明需供雇员居住）。
keyPoints.en: Landlord specific grounds (owner moving in 90+ days, unconditional sale vacant possession): 42 days.

keyPoints.zh: 🎒 **租客主动退租**：缩短至 **21 天**（以前要 28 天），对租客换房更灵活！
keyPoints.en: Tenant ending a periodic tenancy: just 21 days’ written notice.

keyPoints.zh: 📌 **固定期限租约（Fixed-term）到期**：会自动转为周期性租约，除非任意一方在到期前 **90 天至 21 天之间**书面通知不续约。
keyPoints.en: Fixed-term tenancies roll into periodic unless either party gives notice between 90 and 21 days before expiry.

title.zh: 【2025.12.01 生效】养宠租房与宠物押金（Pet Bond）新政全解
title.en: Pet Rules & Pet Bonds (In Force Since 1 Dec 2025)

body.zh: 过去很多房东在广告里直接一刀切写“绝对禁宠”，2025 年 12 月 1 日起实施的新规平衡了双方权益：
body.en: Since 1 December 2025, blanket "no pets" refusals without reasonable grounds are no longer permitted:

keyPoints.zh: 书面申请与 21 天答复红线：租客可正式书面申请养宠，房东必须在 **21 个自然日内**书面回复，只能基于**合理理由**拒绝（如房屋无围栏不适合大型犬、物业 Body Corp 禁宠、市议会限养等）。
keyPoints.en: Landlords must reply within 21 calendar days and may only refuse on reasonable grounds.

keyPoints.zh: 宠物押金封顶：同意养宠时，房东可合法要求额外支付最高 **2 周租金的 Pet Bond**（叠加常规最高 4 周 Bond），且同样必须上交政府 Tenancy Services 监管！同一份批准协议不管批 1 只还是 2 只宠物，只收一次封顶 2 周 Pet Bond。
keyPoints.en: Landlords may charge up to 2 weeks’ rent as a separate Pet Bond (lodged with Tenancy Services).

keyPoints.zh: 赔偿责任加重：租客需对宠物造成的**超出正常磨损（Fair wear and tear）的全部损坏**负全责（不再受旧法 4 周租金上限保护），建议给宠物做好训练与防护。
keyPoints.en: Tenants are fully liable for all pet damage beyond fair wear and tear.

title.zh: 【2025.07.01 全面强制】Healthy Homes 五大健康住宅硬指标
title.en: Healthy Homes Standards: 5 Mandatory Requirements (Full Compliance July 2025)

body.zh: 自 **2025 年 7 月 1 日**起，新西兰所有私人出租房**已过最后宽限期，必须 100% 达标**！每份新租约或续约都必须附带房东签字的合规声明书，违者最高可被判罚 **NZ$7,200**！
body.en: As of 1 July 2025, all private rentals must fully comply with all 5 Healthy Homes standards (penalties up to $7,200):

keyPoints.zh: ① **取暖（Heating）**：主客厅必须装有足够功率的固定取暖设备（通常为 Heat Pump），能将客厅加热至 **18°C**。
keyPoints.en: Heating: fixed heater (e.g. Heat Pump) able to heat the main living room to 18°C.

keyPoints.zh: ② **保温棉（Insulation）**：天花板与地板下（只要可施工）必须铺设达标厚度保温棉。
keyPoints.en: Insulation: compliant ceiling and underfloor insulation.

keyPoints.zh: ③ **通风（Ventilation）**：每个卧室/客厅须有可开启窗户；**厨房与浴室必须装有直排室外的抽风机/抽油烟机**（不能只往天花板夹层排！）。
keyPoints.en: Ventilation: openable windows plus externally vented extractor fans in kitchens and bathrooms.

keyPoints.zh: ④ **防潮排水（Moisture & Drainage）**：屋顶排水沟正常、封闭式架空地板下须铺防潮地膜（Ground Moisture Barrier）。
keyPoints.en: Moisture ingress & drainage: working gutters and ground moisture barrier where applicable.

keyPoints.zh: ⑤ **防漏风（Draught Stopping）**：门窗缝隙不得有明显漏风，废弃壁炉须封堵。
keyPoints.en: Draught stopping: block unreasonable gaps around doors/windows and unused fireplaces.

title.zh: 押金（Bond）监管、涨租频次、查房与维权武器
title.en: Bond Protection, Rent Increase Caps, Inspections & 14-Day Notices

body.zh: 把这 5 条租客法定红线刻在脑子里，谁也欺负不了你：
body.en: Know these 5 non-negotiable tenant rights under NZ law:

keyPoints.zh: ① **押金必须进政府账**：房东收到押金后 **23 个工作日内**必须递交 Tenancy Services；你一定会收到政府发的 **Bond Number 确认邮件/信**——如果 1 个月没收到，立刻打 `0800 737 666` 核查！
keyPoints.en: Bond must be lodged within 23 working days—watch for your official Bond Number confirmation.

keyPoints.zh: ② **涨租频率红线**：每 **12 个月最多只能涨一次租**，且必须提前 **60 天**书面通知（固定租约期内一般不能涨，除非合同明确约定）。
keyPoints.en: Rent can only increase once every 12 months with at least 60 days’ written notice.

keyPoints.zh: ③ **房东查房（Inspection）**：最多每 **4 周**查一次，且必须提前 **48 小时**书面通知，只能在早 8 点至晚 7 点之间来！未经通知擅自拿钥匙开门属严重违法。
keyPoints.en: Inspections max once every 4 weeks with 48 hours’ written notice (8am–7pm only).

keyPoints.zh: ④ **报修拖延怎么办？** 书面催修不管用时，直接上 `tenancy.govt.nz` 下载发出 **14-Day Notice to Remedy（14 天限期整改通知）**，到期不修可直接申请 Tenancy Tribunal 判赔减租！
keyPoints.en: If urgent repairs are ignored, serve a formal 14-Day Notice to Remedy before applying to the Tenancy Tribunal.

keyPoints.zh: ⑤ **退租只赔“人为损坏”**：正常使用老化（Fair wear and tear，如地毯轻微压痕、墙面自然微旧）房东无权扣押金！
keyPoints.en: Landlords cannot deduct bond for fair wear and tear.

title.zh: 实用邮件模板：申请养宠 / 催促房东维修 / 正常提前 21 天退租
title.en: Ready-to-Use Tenant Email Templates (Pet Request / Repairs / 21-Day Notice)

body.zh: 新西兰租房维权一切以**礼貌但清晰的书面邮件**为最高准则：
body.en: Always keep landlord communication polite, concise, and in writing:

dialogueLines.speaker: You (21-Day Periodic Notice)
dialogueLines.en: Kia ora [Landlord/Manager], please accept this email as our formal 21 days’ written notice to end our periodic tenancy at [Address]. Our final day of tenancy will be [Date]. Could we arrange a mutually convenient time for the final inspection and Bond Refund form? Ngā mihi, [Name]
dialogueLines.zh: 你好 [房东/经理]，特此邮件提交正式 21 天书面退租通知（地址：[地址]），最终退租日为 [日期]。请问方便预约哪天做退租验房并签署 Bond Refund 退押金表？诚挚感谢，[姓名]
dialogueLines.subtextZh: 记住提前多留 1–2 天缓冲计算“送达日”，退租验房当场一起签好 Bond Refund 表最省心！

prompt.zh: 你在 2026 年处于周期性租约（Periodic Tenancy），想向房东申请养一只中型宠物狗。根据 2025.12 生效的新政，以下哪项正确？
prompt.en: Under the Dec 2025 pet rules, you request permission to keep a dog in your rental. Which is true?

text.zh: 房东须在 21 个自然日内书面回复，仅可基于合理理由拒绝；若同意，可额外收最高 2 周租金的 Pet Bond
text.en: Landlord must reply within 21 days, can only refuse on reasonable grounds, and may charge up to 2 weeks Pet Bond

feedback.zh: 完全准确！记住 Pet Bond 同样要上交 Tenancy Services 监管，但宠物造成的人为损坏需由租客全额赔偿。
feedback.en: Spot on!

text.zh: 房东可以直接写“我就是不喜欢动物”无理由拒绝，或收 6 周宠物押金
text.en: Landlords can refuse without reason or demand 6 weeks pet bond

feedback.zh: 违反 2025.12 新政！禁止无合理理由一刀切禁宠，且 Pet Bond 严格封顶 2 周租金。
feedback.en: Breaches the Dec 2025 rules—reasonable grounds are required and Pet Bond caps at 2 weeks.

prompt.zh: 2026 年你签下新租约，住进去发现浴室根本没有直排室外的抽风机，房东却说“老房子都这样，不给装”。合法吗？
prompt.en: In 2026 your rental bathroom has no externally vented extractor fan and the landlord refuses to install one. Is this legal?

text.zh: 违法！2025 年 7 月 1 日起所有私房已强制全面达到 Healthy Homes 标准，可发 14 天限期整改通知并向 Tenancy Tribunal 申诉
text.en: Unlawful! All private rentals had to comply with Healthy Homes by 1 July 2025; issue a 14-Day Notice to Remedy

feedback.zh: 太懂法了！未达标房东最高可被判罚 NZ$7,200 赔偿给租客。
feedback.en: Correct—non-compliance carries exemplary damages up to $7,200.

text.zh: 老房子可以永久豁免抽风机要求
text.en: Older houses are permanently exempt from bathroom ventilation

feedback.zh: 只有极少数物理结构确实无法安装的特殊情况才符合狭义豁免，绝大多数老房都必须合规改造！
feedback.en: Only narrow physical-impossibility exemptions exist.

actionTip.zh: 核查你的租房押金邮件确认单（Bond Number）以及 Healthy Homes 合规声明书；遇到纠纷可免费致电 Tenancy Services：0800 836 262。
actionTip.en: Confirm you received your official Bond Number email and Healthy Homes statement; free help: 0800 836 262.

title.zh: 水电网比价、冬季除湿防霉与新西兰各城市水费潜规则
title.en: Utilities, Winter Dampness Control & NZ City Water Billing Differences

summary.zh: 用 Powerswitch 省下上千刀电费、搞懂“先除湿再制热”的南半球越冬秘诀，以及奥克兰水费分摊 vs 惠灵顿/基督城房东包水费的巨大城市差异。
summary.en: Save hundreds with Powerswitch, master NZ winter condensation control, and learn why Auckland tenants pay metered water while Wellington/Christchurch differ.

terms.zh: Consumer NZ 运营的官方免费电力/燃气比价网 powerswitch.org.nz
免费用电时段（如 Electric Kiwi 每天自选 1 小时免费、Contact 晚 9 点后免费）
新西兰全国光纤宽带（Chorus 铺设，常见 300Mbps/900Mbps 不限量）
除湿机（新西兰木结构房冬季防发霉、快速晾衣的续命神器！）
奥克兰水务局（奥克兰整租租客须支付水费中的「按表用量费」，固定接驳费归房东）
冬季窗面冷凝水（早上不擦不通风极易长黑霉菌）

title.zh: 电力、燃气与宽带省钱实操：绝不傻傻沿用上任租客的套餐！
title.en: Electricity, Gas & Fibre: How to Compare and Save Hundreds

body.zh: 新西兰电力市场完全竞争，有超过 30 家售电公司（Contact、Mercury、Genesis、Meridian、Powershop、Electric Kiwi、Frank Energy、Flick 等），不同套餐一年差价可达 **NZ$400–$900**！
body.en: NZ has 30+ competing power retailers—choosing the right plan easily saves NZ$400–$900 per year:

keyPoints.zh: ① **比价第一步**：上 Consumer NZ 公益免费的 **powerswitch.org.nz**，输入地址与大致人口，立刻算出你家最划算的电力/燃气组合！
keyPoints.en: Always check powerswitch.org.nz (by Consumer NZ) first.

keyPoints.zh: ② **错峰免费电神器**：家里有烘干机、洗碗机、电车充电的，优先选 **Contact Good Nights（每晚 9pm–12am 免费 3 小时）** 或 **Electric Kiwi（每天自选 1 小时免费）**，把大功率电器全定时到免费时段跑！
keyPoints.en: Shift dishwashers, dryers, and EV charging into off-peak/free-power plans like Contact Good Nights or Electric Kiwi.

keyPoints.zh: ③ **宽带光纤（Fibre）**：先查地址是否已装墙面 **ONT 光纤盒**（没装可免费申请 Chorus 上门安装，但租客须先征得房东同意）；常见靠谱运营商：2degrees、Skinny Broadband、Voyager、One NZ、Spark、Now。
keyPoints.en: Check for an installed ONT Fibre box—landlord permission is needed for a brand-new Chorus installation.

title.zh: 新西兰各城市「水费谁来付」巨大差异（防被房东乱收费！）
title.en: Who Pays the Water Bill? Huge Differences Across NZ Cities

body.zh: 很多刚从奥克兰搬去惠灵顿、或刚落地的新移民搞不清租房水费谁掏钱，记住法律规则：**只有装了独立水表且账单按实际用量计费时，租客才需付“用水量费（Volumetric Usage）”**！
body.en: Under NZ tenancy law, tenants only pay for water when the property has a separate meter and bills are based strictly on usage:

keyPoints.zh: 🌊 **奥克兰（Auckland / Watercare）**与 **陶朗加（Tauranga）**：普遍装有独立水表。**租客付**：实际用水费 + 排污按量费（Volumetric）；**房东付**：年度固定接驳费（Fixed Charge）！如果房东把固定费也摊给你，礼貌拒绝！
keyPoints.en: Auckland & Tauranga (metered): tenants pay volumetric usage + wastewater; landlords MUST pay fixed charges.

keyPoints.zh: 🌊 **惠灵顿（Wellington）与基督城（Christchurch）**：住宅水费通常包含在房东每年交给市议会的地税（Rates）里，**绝大多数普通整租租客不需要单独付水费**（基督城仅超额用水才收附加费）！
keyPoints.en: Wellington & Christchurch: normal residential water is generally included in council rates paid by the landlord.

keyPoints.zh: 🌊 **农村/生活方式大块地（Lifestyle Block）**：很多靠屋顶收集雨水进 **Water Tank（蓄水罐）**，干季没水了需要叫水车（Water Delivery）买水，签约前务必问清谁出钱！
keyPoints.en: Rural/lifestyle properties often use rainwater tanks—clarify tank refill costs before signing.

title.zh: 南半球木结构房越冬秘籍：除湿、通风与防黑霉菌
title.en: Surviving NZ Winter Indoors: Dehumidifying & Mould Prevention

body.zh: 新西兰绝大多数独栋房屋是木结构且没有国内那种“全屋集中暖气”。冬季多雨潮湿（6–8 月），如果紧闭门窗并在室内晾衣服，窗玻璃每天流下大片冷凝水，几周就能长出危害呼吸道的黑霉斑！
body.en: NZ’s timber-framed homes rely on individual heating rather than central radiators. Managing winter moisture is essential for health and avoiding mould:

keyPoints.zh: ① **每天通风 15 分钟**：即使冬天，早上出太阳时也把南北/前后窗对流打开 10–15 分钟换干空气，并用刮水器（Window Vac）或干毛巾擦掉窗玻璃冷凝水。
keyPoints.en: Air the house for 10–15 minutes daily and wipe morning window condensation.

keyPoints.zh: ② **干燥的空气更好加热！** 买一台靠谱的 **除湿机（Dehumidifier，如三菱/松下/Goldair）**，雨季室内晾衣开除湿机，不仅一夜干透，还能大幅降低 Heat Pump 制热电费！
keyPoints.en: Dry air heats far faster and cheaper—a good dehumidifier is one of the best NZ investments you can make.

keyPoints.zh: ③ **做饭/洗澡必开抽风机**，并把家具离外墙留出 5–10 厘米空隙透气，否则衣柜背后极易发霉（租客因不通风导致的霉菌可能被扣押金）。
keyPoints.en: Always run kitchen/bathroom extractor fans and leave a small airflow gap behind beds/wardrobes against exterior walls.

title.zh: 水电网避坑：搬走前必须主动停户 & 警惕捆绑合约违约金
title.en: Utility Traps: Final Meter Readings & Bundled Break Fees

body.zh: 退租搬家时千万别只交钥匙就拍屁股走人：
body.en: Two common bill traps when moving house:

keyPoints.zh: 搬走前 **提前 5–7 天**通知电力、燃气、宽带公司办理 **Move House（移机）或 Disconnect（停户）**，并拍下离开当天电表照片，否则下一任租客用的电全记在你账上！
keyPoints.en: Give power/broadband providers 5–7 days’ notice before moving out and photograph final meter readings.

keyPoints.zh: 签“送电视/送家电/送 $300 抵扣券”的 12–24 个月电力宽带捆绑约前，先看清提前解约费（Early Termination Fee，往往高达 $200–$400）及单位电价是否暗藏溢价！
keyPoints.en: Check break fees ($200–$400) and per-kWh unit rates before signing 12–24 month “free gift” bundles.

prompt.zh: 你在奥克兰整租了一套独立水表住宅，收到房东转发的 Watercare 水费单，里面包含“实际用水/排污费”和“年度固定接驳费（Fixed Charge）”。法律规定你应该付哪部分？
prompt.en: In an individually metered Auckland rental, the Watercare bill lists volumetric usage/wastewater and a fixed annual charge. What must the tenant pay?

text.zh: 只付按表计量的实际用水与排污费；固定接驳费（Fixed Charge）必须由房东承担
text.en: Only the volumetric usage & wastewater charges; the landlord must pay fixed charges

feedback.zh: 精准维护自身权益！这是 Tenancy Services 明确规定的硬界线。
feedback.en: Spot on!

text.zh: 水费单上写多少钱租客就全额付多少钱
text.en: The tenant must pay the entire invoice including fixed charges

feedback.zh: 错啦！固定接驳费属于房屋持有成本，依法归房东支付。
feedback.en: Fixed supply charges are a landlord ownership cost under NZ law.

prompt.zh: 想对比新西兰几十家电力和燃气公司的真实年费，最权威中立的免费比价网站是？
prompt.en: Which free, independent website (run by Consumer NZ) compares NZ electricity and gas plans?

text.zh: powerswitch.org.nz
text.en: powerswitch.org.nz

feedback.zh: 完全正确！搬家换电或每年冬前查一次 Powerswitch，常能省下几百纽币。
feedback.en: Correct!

text.zh: trademe.co.nz/power
text.en: trademe.co.nz/power

feedback.zh: 比价电力和燃气认准 Consumer NZ 的 powerswitch.org.nz 哦！
feedback.en: Use Consumer NZ’s powerswitch.org.nz.

actionTip.zh: 打开 powerswitch.org.nz 核对一次当前电费套餐，并在雨季来临前备好一台靠谱的除湿机！
actionTip.en: Run your address through powerswitch.org.nz to check if you are overpaying for electricity.

title.zh: 垃圾分类、二手淘货（Op Shop / Trade Me）与 Kiwi DIY 五金文化
title.en: Rubbish & Recycling, Op Shops, Trade Me & Kiwi DIY Culture

summary.zh: 融入新西兰日常居家节奏：2024 起全国统一回收标准、用 Op Shop 与 Trade Me 低成本置办全套家具防诈骗，以及逛 Bunnings / Mitre 10 的周末香肠文化。
summary.en: Master NZ’s standardised kerbside recycling, furnish your home affordably via Op Shops & Trade Me without scams, and embrace Bunnings DIY culture.

officialSource: Ministry for the Environment / Local Councils / Trade Me

terms.zh: 路边垃圾清运（清运日前一晚把带轮垃圾桶推到路边，轮子朝向自家）
慈善二手商店（Salvation Army / Hospice / Red Cross / Vinnies，家具厨具超便宜！）
大件垃圾清运（如奥克兰每年可免费预约 1 次上门收旧家具/坏电器）
新西兰两大国民五金园艺巨头（买工具、灯泡、除草、DIY 必逛）
五金店门口周末公益烤香肠吐司（约 $3.50，极具代表性的 Kiwi 社区文化！）
8 号铁丝精神（新西兰人崇尚自力更生、巧手修补 DIY 的民族性格）

title.zh: 新西兰全国统一垃圾分类规则（红/黄/绿桶绝不放错！）
title.en: NZ Standardised Kerbside Recycling Rules (Red / Yellow / Green Bins)

body.zh: 新西兰近年来统一了全国路边回收（Yellow Bin）标准，**千万别把软塑料袋、脏披萨盒或碎玻璃丢进黄桶**，否则整桶可能被市议会贴红条拒收！
body.en: NZ standardised kerbside recycling nationwide—putting soft plastics or unwashed containers in the yellow bin can get your bin rejected:

keyPoints.zh: 🔴 **红桶（Rubbish 一般垃圾）**：不可回收的生活垃圾、软塑料包装、保鲜膜、纸巾、尿不湿、碎陶瓷/碎玻璃（包好防割伤）。
keyPoints.en: Red bin: general rubbish, soft plastics, tissues, nappies, broken crockery.

keyPoints.zh: 🟡 **黄桶（Recycling 可回收 — 须冲净晾干、拧掉瓶盖！）**：仅收 **塑料编号 1、2、5 号硬质容器**、铁铝易拉罐、玻璃瓶罐（部分城市有独立蓝框收玻璃）、干净纸板纸张。**软塑料（超市袋/薯片袋）只能带去超市门口的 Soft Plastic Recycling 回收箱**！
keyPoints.en: Yellow bin: clean #1, #2, #5 rigid plastics (lids off), tins/cans, clean paper/cardboard, glass bottles (or separate glass crate).

keyPoints.zh: 🟢 **绿桶（Food Scraps / Garden 厨余与花园）**：奥克兰等城市配有小绿桶收厨余（果皮菜叶剩饭，一周一收），另可租花园大绿桶收剪下的草坪树枝。
keyPoints.en: Green bin: food scraps (weekly in cities like Auckland) and garden waste.

title.zh: 省钱安家宝藏：Op Shop 慈善二手店 + Trade Me + Kmart
title.en: Furnishing Your NZ Home Smartly: Op Shops, Trade Me & Kmart

body.zh: 新西兰人工贵、全新实木家具价格惊人，本地 Kiwi 家庭（无论贫富）都非常热爱环保循环的二手文化：
body.en: New furniture can be pricey in NZ, and Kiwis of all backgrounds proudly embrace second-hand quality:

keyPoints.zh: 🛋️ **Op Shop 慈善二手店**：认准 **Salvation Army Family Store、Hospice Shop、Vinnies、Red Cross Shop、Habitat ReStore**。几十纽币就能淘到结实的实木餐桌、书架、餐具和童书，所得全做慈善！
keyPoints.en: Hospice, Salvation Army, and Habitat ReStore offer solid timber furniture and kitchenware for a fraction of retail.

keyPoints.zh: 💻 **Trade Me（新西兰版淘宝+闲鱼）**：买二手冰箱、洗衣机、实木床、二手车和租房的核心阵地，优先选有 **Ping 平台担保支付** 或 **同城当面验货自提（Pick-up）** 的高好评卖家。
keyPoints.en: On Trade Me, prefer Ping buyer-protected payments or in-person cash/bank-transfer pickup.

keyPoints.zh: 🛒 **平价新品**：日常锅碗瓢盆、床品、收纳盒去 **Kmart / The Warehouse / Briscoes**（牢记 Briscoes 潜规则：**绝不买原价**，几乎每两周就有全场 40%–60% 大促！）。
keyPoints.en: Never pay full price at Briscoes—wait a week for their constant 40–60% sales!

title.zh: Trade Me 与 Facebook Marketplace 买卖防骗红线
title.en: Second-Hand Trading Anti-Scam Rules (Trade Me & FB Marketplace)

body.zh: 新西兰二手交易整体诚信度很高，但近两年针对新移民的 **假快递链接骗局（Courier Scam）** 非常猖獗：
body.en: Watch out for the surging fake-courier phishing scam on Facebook Marketplace and Trade Me:

keyPoints.zh: ❌ 只要买家声称“我叫 NZ Post / Aramex 上门取货并先付钱，你点这个链接填银行卡收款”——**100% 是钓鱼诈骗**！NZ Post 绝不代收二手货款！
keyPoints.en: Anyone claiming “NZ Post will collect and pay you via this link” is 100% a scammer!

keyPoints.zh: ❌ 当面交易只看“对方手机转账截图”就放货——高危！对方可能用假图或撤销延迟转账，大额交易务必确认**自己银行 App 真实入账**或收现金。
keyPoints.en: Screenshots can be faked—confirm cleared funds in your own bank app or accept cash on pickup.

title.zh: 读懂 Kiwi 灵魂：周末 Bunnings / Mitre 10 与「8 号铁丝 DIY 精神」
title.en: Kiwi DIY Culture: Bunnings, Mitre 10 & the No. 8 Wire Spirit

body.zh: 在新西兰请电工、水管工、木工上门一次动辄 **NZ$120–$200 起步**，因此几乎每个 Kiwi 家里都有一把电钻，周末最爱去 **Bunnings Warehouse** 或 **Mitre 10** 买材料自己修花园、刷露台（Deck）！
body.en: Because trades labour is expensive, Kiwis take huge pride in DIY—making Bunnings and Mitre 10 weekend social hubs:

keyPoints.zh: 🌭 周末门口的 **Sausage Sizzle**：当地学校、运动队或慈善机构常在 Bunnings 门口烤洋葱香肠吐司筹款（约 NZ$3.50），买一根边吃边逛是超地道的 Kiwi 体验！
keyPoints.en: Grab a fundraising sausage sizzle outside Bunnings on weekends—pure Kiwi tradition.

keyPoints.zh: ⚖️ DIY 法律红线：刷墙、换门把手、修花园、装窗帘都可以自己动手；但**涉及固定强电布线、给排水主管道和燃气设备，依法必须请新西兰持牌电工/水工/燃气工**，私改不仅违法还会导致房屋保险拒赔！
keyPoints.en: DIY safely: painting and gardening are fine, but fixed electrical, plumbing, and gas work legally require licensed NZ tradespeople or your house insurance can be voided.

prompt.zh: 整理家里垃圾时，超市塑料购物袋、薯片软包装袋以及拧下来的塑料瓶盖，应该怎么投放？
prompt.en: How should soft plastic bags, chip packets, and plastic bottle lids be disposed of under NZ kerbside rules?

text.zh: 全丢进黄桶（Recycling），因为都是塑料
text.en: Put all of them in the yellow recycling bin

feedback.zh: 错啦！软塑料会缠绕卡死分拣机器，小瓶盖太小无法分拣，这样扔会导致黄桶被拒收！
feedback.en: Incorrect—soft plastics jam sorting machines and small lids fall through.

text.zh: 瓶盖丢红桶，干净的软塑料袋带去超市门口 Soft Plastic 回收箱；黄桶只放洗净的 1/2/5 号硬塑料瓶
text.en: Lids in red bin, clean soft plastics to supermarket drop-off bins, only clean #1/#2/#5 rigid plastics in yellow bin

feedback.zh: 超标准的 Kiwi 环保达人！
feedback.en: Spot on!

prompt.zh: 你在 Facebook Marketplace 卖一台二手微波炉，对方立刻发来一条“NZ Post 快递代付收款链接”让你输入银行卡号和验证码收款。你应该？
prompt.en: A FB Marketplace buyer sends you an "NZ Post courier payment link" asking for your bank card details. What should you do?

text.zh: 立刻拉黑举报！这是新西兰高发的假快递钓鱼诈骗
text.en: Block and report immediately—it is a classic NZ courier phishing scam

feedback.zh: 火眼金睛！二手交易绝不点陌生收款链接。
feedback.en: Great catch!

text.zh: 填借记卡号进去收钱，反正是收款不怕
text.en: Enter your debit card details to receive the money

feedback.zh: 千万别填！收款只需要银行账号，凡是问你要卡号+有效期+CVV 的 100% 是盗刷！
feedback.en: Never enter card CVV/expiry to “receive” money—it steals your funds immediately.

actionTip.zh: 搜一下你家附近的 Hospice / Salvation Army Op Shop 和本地市议会官网的 Rubbish Collection Day（垃圾清运日查询）。
actionTip.en: Look up your council’s kerbside collection day and visit a local Hospice or Salvation Army Op Shop this weekend.

title.zh: 新西兰买房入门全流程：拍卖/议价、产权类型与避坑尽调
title.en: Buying a Home in NZ: Sale Methods, Title Types & Due Diligence

summary.zh: 看懂 Auction 拍卖、Tender、Deadline Sale 与议价的本质差别，彻底分清 Freehold / Cross-lease / Unit Title 三大产权，掌握 LIM、Building Report 与律师尽调流程。
summary.en: Decode NZ property sale methods, compare Freehold vs Cross-lease vs Unit Title, and run airtight LIM, Builder’s Report, and solicitor due diligence.

terms.zh: 永久完全产权（独立土地+房屋，最省心保值）
交叉租赁产权（多户共享整块地，改建须邻居同意且需查 Flats Plan 是否一致！）
公寓/联排共有产权（每年须交物业管理费 Body Corporate Levy，关注长期维修基金）
市议会土地信息备忘录（查洪水区、滑坡区、违建 CCC 验收记录的核心文件！）
建筑合规验收证（加建/改建若缺 CCC 极易影响贷款、保险与转卖）
无条件出价（如拍卖举牌成交即具法律约束力，通常当场付 10% 定金且不可反悔！）

title.zh: 四大卖房方式拆解（拍卖 vs 议价 vs 截止出价 vs 暗标）
title.en: 4 NZ Property Sale Methods Explained

body.zh: 新西兰买房很少只看一口价，不同销售方式的博弈规则和风险截然不同（官方指南见 **settled.govt.nz**）：
body.en: Understanding how a home is being sold determines when you must finish your due diligence:

keyPoints.zh: 🔨 **Auction（公开拍卖）**：一旦落槌即为**无条件成交（Unconditional）**！必须**在拍卖前**就花钱做完贷款预批、律师审产权、LIM 和验房报告，中标当天交 10% 定金不可反悔！
keyPoints.en: Auction: unconditionally binding the moment the hammer falls—complete ALL finance, legal, and builder checks BEFORE auction day!

keyPoints.zh: 🤝 **By Negotiation / Asking Price（议价 / 标价）**：最适合首次购房者！可以下 **有条件出价（Conditional Offer）**，写明“10 个工作日内通过贷款审批、满意 LIM 与验房报告才生效”，不满意可合法退出不丢定金。
keyPoints.en: Negotiation / Asking Price: safest for first-home buyers—submit a Conditional Offer subject to finance, LIM, and builder’s report.

keyPoints.zh: ⏳ **Deadline Sale（截止日期出价）** & **Tender（密封暗标）**：买家在指定截止日前递交报价（均可附带条件），卖家综合价格与条件挑一家谈。
keyPoints.en: Deadline Sale / Tender: submit your best written offer (conditional or unconditional) before the closing date.

title.zh: 新西兰三大核心产权类型（千万别只看房价不看 Title！）
title.en: NZ Property Title Types: Freehold vs Cross-Lease vs Unit Title

body.zh: 同样 80 万纽币的房子，产权不同隐藏成本天差地别：
body.en: Always inspect the Record of Title before falling in love with a house:

keyPoints.zh: 🏡 **Freehold（Fee Simple 永久完全产权）**：你完全拥有房子和脚下那块独立土地，改建只走市议会审批，不受邻居或物业掣肘，流通性最好。
keyPoints.en: Freehold: full ownership of land and house—simplest and most liquid.

keyPoints.zh: 🏘️ **Cross-lease（交叉租赁）**：几户共享一大块地，再互相签 999 年租约。**大坑警告**：必查产权里的 **Flats Plan 平面图**！如果前屋主私搭了阳光房/车库却没更新 Flats Plan，属于**产权瑕疵（Defective Title）**，银行可能拒贷！
keyPoints.en: Cross-lease: shared land—ALWAYS check the Flats Plan matches actual structures, or it is a defective title!

keyPoints.zh: 🏢 **Unit Title（公寓/部分联排）**：须按年缴纳 **Body Corporate Levy（物业费，常达 NZ$4,000–$12,000+/年）**。必看 **Pre-contract Disclosure Statement** 和近 3 年业主大会纪要，查清大楼有无**漏水（Leaky Building）或天价大修分摊（Special Levy）**！
keyPoints.en: Unit Title: review Body Corp minutes, Long-Term Maintenance Plan, and check for leaky-building special levies!

keyPoints.zh: ⚠️ **Leasehold（租赁地权 — 慎碰！）**：只买地上建筑、地皮归别人，每隔几年地租（Ground Rent）暴涨且极难转手，新手强烈避开！
keyPoints.en: Leasehold: you own the building but pay escalating ground rent—generally avoid unless you are an expert.

title.zh: 首次买房 6 步安全闭环（含 KiwiSaver 提取与海外买家资格）
title.en: 6-Step Safe First-Home Buying Workflow in NZ

body.zh: 新西兰买房由**持牌过户律师（Property Lawyer / Conveyancer）**与**贷款经纪（Mortgage Adviser，通常免费，由银行付佣）**全程把关：
body.en: Work with a licensed NZ property lawyer and a mortgage adviser from day one:

keyPoints.zh: ① **确认购房资格**：受《海外投资法》限制，通常须持有 **NZ 公民、PRV 或已满足“居住满 1 年且过去 12 个月住满 183 天”的居民签（RV）** 才能买二手住宅（工签一般不可买普通二手房）。
keyPoints.en: Verify eligibility: citizens, PRV, or residents meeting the 1-year / 183-day ordinarily-resident test (most work visas cannot buy existing homes).

keyPoints.zh: ② **准备首付（Deposit）与贷款预批**：自住房通常需 **20% 首付**（部分符合低首付 LVR 或 Kāinga Ora First Home Loan 条件可 10%–5%）；加入 **KiwiSaver 满 3 年**可提取几乎全部余额作首套房首付（至少留 NZ$1,000 在账户内）。
keyPoints.en: Aim for 20% deposit (KiwiSaver First Home Withdrawal available after 3 years of membership, leaving $1,000 minimum).

keyPoints.zh: ③ **核查三大尽调文件**：**LIM Report**（看洪水区 Flood Zone、滑坡与 CCC 验收）、**独立持牌验房报告（Building Inspection）**（测墙体含水率防 1990–2004 年代“漏水房 Leaky Home”）、**律师审 Title 与买卖合同（S&P Agreement）**。
keyPoints.en: Run the golden trio: Council LIM Report (flood zones/CCC), accredited Building Inspection (moisture test), and Solicitor review.

keyPoints.zh: ④ **确认房屋全险（Full Replacement Insurance）**：无条件生效前务必拿到保险公司书面承保报价（老房、地震带或洪水区若买不到保险，银行会立刻撤回贷款！）。
keyPoints.en: Secure written house insurance confirmation BEFORE going unconditional—banks will not settle without it!

title.zh: 新西兰买房 4 大天价深坑（踩中一个可能亏掉几十万）
title.en: 4 Costly NZ Property Traps to Spot Immediately

body.zh: 买房切忌冲动，这 4 类房子务必提高十级警惕：
body.en: Stay alert for these 4 notorious NZ property hazards:

keyPoints.zh: ① **Plaster / Monolithic Cladding 漏水房高危期（约 1992–2004 建）**：无防雨空腔（Cavity）的灰泥外墙老房极易内部腐烂，必须做侵入式/红外湿气检测。
keyPoints.en: 1992–2004 monolithic plaster homes without drainage cavities carry high weathertightness risk.

keyPoints.zh: ② **未获批违建（Unconsented Works）**：前屋主私自多隔卫生间、封车库改卧室却没拿市议会 **CCC**，保险公司可能拒赔火灾/漏水！
keyPoints.en: Unconsented bathrooms or garage conversions without CCC can invalidate house insurance.

keyPoints.zh: ③ **洪水淹没区（Flood Plain / Overland Flow Path）**：经历 2023 年奥克兰大洪水后，查市议会 GeoMaps 洪水图层已成为全纽买房硬步骤！
keyPoints.en: Always inspect council GeoMaps for flood plains and overland flow paths.

keyPoints.zh: ④ **绝不要依赖卖家中介（Agent）给你的口头承诺**：在新西兰，房产中介法律上只代表**卖家**拿佣金！任何承诺必须让你的律师白纸黑字写进合同。
keyPoints.en: Real estate agents legally work for the SELLER—rely on your own independent lawyer and builder.

prompt.zh: 你准备去参加一场新西兰房产 Auction（现场拍卖），以下哪种做法是绝对正确的？
prompt.en: You plan to bid at an NZ property auction. What is the only safe approach?

text.zh: 先拍下来锁定房子，再慢慢申请银行贷款和找验房师检查
text.en: Win the auction first, then arrange finance and building inspection

feedback.zh: 极其致命！拍卖落槌即为无条件成交，如果之后贷不下款或查出漏水，你会痛失 10% 定金并面临违约索赔！
feedback.en: Catastrophic risk! Auction bids are unconditional—failing to settle can forfeit your 10% deposit and more.

text.zh: 必须在拍卖日之前全部完成贷款预批、律师审合同与 Title、查 LIM 报告、验房与确认房屋保险可承保
text.en: Complete finance approval, solicitor review, LIM, building inspection, and insurance confirmation BEFORE auction day

feedback.zh: 教科书级稳健买房纪律！
feedback.en: Spot on!

prompt.zh: 看中一套 1980 年代的 Cross-lease 产权房，屋主当年自己在后院加建了一间阳光房。尽调时最关键要查什么？
prompt.en: You are looking at a Cross-lease home where the owner added a conservatory years ago. What must your lawyer check?

text.zh: 核对产权里的 Flats Plan 平面图是否已更新涵盖该加建（并查有无市议会 CCC 及邻居书面同意）
text.en: Check if the Flats Plan on the Title was updated to include the addition (plus CCC and neighbour consent)

feedback.zh: 太专业了！未更新 Flats Plan 构成产权瑕疵，买前可要求卖家整改或借此大幅谈价。
feedback.en: Exactly right!

text.zh: 只要房子看着结实、阳光房不漏雨就不用管平面图
text.en: If it looks sturdy and dry, the Flats Plan does not matter

feedback.zh: 大坑！产权图与实物不符会导致银行拒贷、保险拒赔，未来转手也会被下家砍价。
feedback.en: Defective cross-lease titles frequently block mortgages and resale.

actionTip.zh: 收藏新西兰房产局官方免费中立指南网站 settled.govt.nz，买房前用它核对每一步流程与检查清单。
actionTip.en: Bookmark settled.govt.nz—New Zealand’s free, impartial official home-buying guide.

title.zh: 房屋持有成本、保险、树篱围栏法与新西兰邻里边界
title.en: Homeownership Costs, Insurance, Fencing Act & Neighbour Etiquette

summary.zh: 买完房才是开始！搞懂年度地税（Rates）、房屋/家财险（Sum Insured）、围栏费用平摊法（Fencing Act），以及噪音、修树与木结构房维护常识。
summary.en: Budget for ongoing ownership: Council Rates, Sum Insured house insurance, the Fencing Act 1978, noise control, overhanging trees, and timber maintenance.

officialSource: Consumer Protection NZ / Fencing Act 1978 / Local Councils

terms.zh: 地方市议会地税（按房屋估价 RV 每年分季缴纳，用于修路/垃圾/图书馆/公园）
房屋保险定额重建保额（按当今建筑成本估算，设太低出事不够重建！）
新西兰自然灾害委员会（原 EQC，随房屋险自动附带最高 $30万+GST 地震/滑坡基础赔付）
《围栏法》（两家共用边界围栏需维修/重建时，遵循规范程序可由双方各付一半）
市议会 24/7 噪音管制热线（遇到邻居深夜狂欢轰趴扰民直接打市议会投诉）
清理屋顶排水槽（木结构房每年至少清 1–2 次落叶，防雨水倒灌腐烂屋檐）

title.zh: 算清房屋“隐形持有成本”（绝不只是还房贷！）
title.en: The True Ongoing Cost of Owning a Home in New Zealand

body.zh: 很多新移民买房时只算了房贷月供，住进去才发现新西兰养房固定支出非常可观，务必提前按年做好预算：
body.en: Beyond your mortgage repayments, budget annually for these mandatory ownership costs:

keyPoints.zh: 🏛️ **地税（Council Rates）**：每年约 **NZ$3,000–$6,000+**（因城市与房产估价而异，通常分 4 季缴纳，奥克兰/惠灵顿近年均有上调）。
keyPoints.en: Council Rates: typically NZ$3,000–$6,000+/yr paid quarterly.

keyPoints.zh: 🛡️ **房屋险（House Insurance）+ 家财险（Contents）**：受气候灾害与地震再保险涨价影响，独栋木屋房屋险每年常达 **NZ$2,000–$4,500+**！务必用 **Cordell Sum Sure** 计算器核准重建保额（Sum Insured），并记得新西兰房屋险默认含 **NHC（原 EQC）地震/自然灾害基础险（$300k + GST）**。
keyPoints.en: House Insurance (~NZ$2k–$4.5k+/yr): accurately estimate rebuild cost (Sum Insured); automatically includes NHC (formerly EQC) natural hazard cover.

keyPoints.zh: 🔧 **年度维护基金**：经验法则是每年预留房价的 **1% 左右**，用于每 7–10 年重刷外墙木漆、清理屋顶排水沟（Gutter）、保养 Heat Pump 滤网与屋顶防锈。
keyPoints.en: Set aside ~1% of home value per year for exterior repainting, gutter cleaning, and roof maintenance.

title.zh: 邻里相处黄金法则：围栏费、越界树枝与深夜噪音
title.en: Good Neighbour Rules: Shared Fences, Trees & Noise Control

body.zh: 新西兰住宅区强调**尊重隐私与边界感（Good fences make good neighbours）**，遇到邻里小摩擦按本地规矩办最体面：
body.en: Kiwi suburbs value privacy, polite communication, and clear legal boundaries:

keyPoints.zh: 🪵 **共用围栏（Fencing Act 1978）**：两家之间的边界围栏腐烂倒塌要重修，通常**双方各付 50% 合理造价**！但千万别先斩后奏自己找人修完再找邻居要钱——必须先友好沟通，或正式发出 **Fencing Notice（21 天异议期）**！
keyPoints.en: Shared boundary fences are usually split 50/50 under the Fencing Act—always agree or serve a Fencing Notice BEFORE starting work.

keyPoints.zh: 🌳 **邻居树枝伸进我家院子**：先礼貌沟通请邻居修剪；法律上你**有权自己剪掉伸过边界线的树枝**（不可踏入邻居院子、不可伤及树木存活），剪下的树枝礼貌归还或自行清理。
keyPoints.en: You may trim branches encroaching over your boundary line (without trespassing or killing the tree), ideally after a friendly chat first.

keyPoints.zh: 🔊 **噪音扰民（Noise Control）**：周末偶尔白天割草、办 BBQ 很正常（提前跟隔壁打个招呼超加分！）；但如果半夜震天低音炮睡不着，**不要半夜上门吵架**，直接匿名致电当地市议会 24/7 Noise Control，执法官会上门发警告甚至没收音响！
keyPoints.en: For excessive late-night party noise, call your local council’s 24/7 Noise Control rather than confronting drunk neighbours.

title.zh: 木结构独栋房年度保养 5 件事（延长 20 年寿命、少花几万块）
title.en: 5 Annual Maintenance Habits for NZ Timber Homes

body.zh: 新西兰气候紫外线强、冬季雨水多，木头房“怕水怕晒”，每年花两个周末做基础维护能省大钱：
body.en: NZ’s intense UV and wet winters are tough on timber cladding—simple yearly upkeep prevents costly rot:

keyPoints.zh: ① 每年春秋清理一次屋顶 **Gutter（排水槽）** 与落水管，防落叶堵塞造成雨水倒灌进墙体。
keyPoints.en: Clear roof gutters and downpipes twice a year.

keyPoints.zh: ② 每年用软刷中性洗涤剂清洗一次外墙（**House Wash**），洗掉海风盐分、霉苔和蜘蛛网，防止油漆粉化剥落（慎用高压水枪直射木板缝！）。
keyPoints.en: Do an annual gentle soft-wash of exterior cladding (avoid blasting water under weatherboards with high pressure).

keyPoints.zh: ③ 检查卫浴玻璃胶（Silicone Seal）与窗台密封胶是否开裂，发现微裂立刻重打防水胶。
keyPoints.en: Inspect shower and window silicone seals and re-seal any cracks early.

keyPoints.zh: ④ 每 3–6 个月清洗一次 **Heat Pump 室内机滤网**，省电且吹风无异味。
keyPoints.en: Vacuum/wash Heat Pump indoor filters every 3–6 months.

keyPoints.zh: ⑤ 检查全屋 **烟雾报警器（Smoke Alarms）** 电池与 10 年有效期，卧室门口和走廊必装！
keyPoints.en: Test photoelectric smoke alarms at daylight saving clock changes twice a year.

title.zh: 地道邻里沟通话术：商量合修围栏 / 提前打招呼办聚会
title.en: Friendly Kiwi Neighbour Scripts: Shared Fence & Party Heads-Up

body.zh: 一杯咖啡或一张放进信箱的小纸条，就能让你成为整条街最受欢迎的好邻居：
body.en: A quick friendly note in the letterbox works wonders in NZ:

dialogueLines.speaker: You (Note in Neighbour’s Letterbox)
dialogueLines.en: Kia ora neighbours! We’re hosting a small birthday BBQ at #14 this Saturday from 4pm and will wrap up any music by 10pm. Feel free to pop over for a snag, or text me on 021-xxx-xxxx if the noise gets too loud. Cheers, [Your Name]!
dialogueLines.zh: 你好邻居！我们本周六下午 4 点在 14 号办个小生日烧烤，音乐晚上 10 点前肯定关。欢迎过来吃根烤肠，如果觉得吵随时短信我 021-xxx-xxxx！谢谢啦，[你的名字]
dialogueLines.subtextZh: 新西兰人超级吃这一套！提前给个台阶和手机号，几乎没人会投诉你。

prompt.zh: 暴风雨把你和隔壁邻居共用的边界木围栏吹倒了，你非常积极地当天自己花 $4,000 找工人全修好了，然后把 $2,000 账单塞进邻居信箱。邻居依法必须付钱吗？
prompt.en: A storm knocks down your shared fence. You immediately pay $4,000 to rebuild it yourself without telling the neighbour, then hand them a $2,000 bill. Must they pay?

text.zh: 不必！依据《围栏法》你必须事前与邻居达成协议或正式发出 21 天 Fencing Notice，未经同意先斩后奏通常无权强迫分摊
text.en: No—under the Fencing Act you must agree beforehand or serve a formal Fencing Notice before doing the work

feedback.zh: 记住这个经典本地规矩：先沟通拿 2–3 份报价一起挑，既省钱又不伤邻里和气！
feedback.en: Spot on! Always get quotes and agree first.

text.zh: 必须付一半，因为围栏本来就是两家共用的
text.en: Yes, shared fences are automatically 50/50 even without notice

feedback.zh: 错啦！除了极个别防止牲畜走失的紧急抢修外，不提前商量或发通知就施工，邻居有权拒付！
feedback.en: Except in narrow emergency cases, unapproved work is not recoverable.

prompt.zh: 新西兰每年夏令时/冬令时调表（4 月与 9 月）时，消防局（FENZ）都会全国提醒每家每户顺手检查什么安全设备？
prompt.en: Twice a year at daylight saving clock changes, Fire and Emergency NZ reminds every household to test what?

text.zh: 全屋光电式烟雾报警器（Smoke Alarms）是否正常响铃及电池状态
text.en: Test all household photoelectric smoke alarms

feedback.zh: 答对了！“Check your clocks, check your smoke alarms”是全纽家喻户晓的安全口号。
feedback.en: Correct!

text.zh: 给电表换电池
text.en: Replace the electricity meter battery

feedback.zh: 是检查烟雾报警器哦！木结构房一旦起火蔓延极快，烟雾报警器能救命。
feedback.en: It is smoke alarms—critical for NZ timber homes!

actionTip.zh: 无论租房还是自住，今天花 1 分钟按一下家里天花板烟雾报警器的测试键，并记下所在市议会（Council）24 小时服务热线。
actionTip.en: Test your home smoke alarms today and save your local council’s 24/7 phone number.
